title: Vendor Release Cadence Attribution & Renewal Risk Matrix
creator: Anika Patel
description: High-level: Build a reproducible scoring system that attributes vendor behavior (release cadence, breaking changes, deprecation notices, hotfix frequency, public postmortems) to downstream contract renewal risk for enterprise customers. The output will be a renewal-risk matrix and an alerting feed for Sales/Solutions to prioritize retention outreach and negotiation levers. This ticket covers PM coordination, scope definition, data requirements, prototype scoring, and a validation plan with pilot accounts.
background: Sales and Customer Success routinely flag sudden model regressions, unannounced breaking changes, and frequent small breaking releases as leading indicators of churn risk for customers who are sensitive to latency and stability. We currently surface per-model latency and outage alerts, but lack a vendor-behavior view that connects public release patterns and internal incident telemetry to contract renewal risk. Several procurement RFPs referenced 'vendor release discipline' as a purchase criterion during 2025 Q3 enterprise engagements.
goals: Define a vendor-level renewal-risk score derived from public release signals + our telemetry
Ship a pilot dashboard and weekly alert feed for top 50 enterprise accounts
Validate score correlation against historical renewal/expansion outcomes (attempt to retroactively explain past churn events)
Provide Sales with prioritized playbook actions tied to specific vendor behaviors (e.g., request SLA addendum, lock model pinning, negotiate pricing protection)
scope_in: Public vendor release metadata ingestion (GitHub releases, model catalog change logs, published blog posts)
Internal telemetry signals: incident count, latency SLO breaches, model-substitution fallbacks used per-customer
Prototype dashboard in Looker/Console and weekly CSV alert feed to Sales
Pilot focused on top 50 enterprise accounts and top 12 vendor families
scope_out: Automated contract changes or legal negotiations (we will only surface recommendations)
Full productized SLA or billing changes (out of scope for this sprint)
On-prem/private vendor telemetry ingestion beyond publicly available signals for prospective vendors
success_metrics: Pilot score correlates with renewal risk: target Pearson r >= 0.35 against known churn/renewal outcomes (retrofit analysis)
Sales adoption: 60% of pilot accounts receive at least one outreach recommended by the feed during pilot window
Time-to-action: median time from alert to Sales outreach <= 7 days for pilot accounts
False positive rate on alerts <= 25% as judged by Sales feedback during pilot
analysis_approach: Combine heuristic signal fusion and a logistic regression baseline. Signals: release_frequency_30d, breaking_change_flag, deprecation_notice_90d, incident_rate_per_model, percent_requests_fallbacked_to_safe_variant, avg_latency_jitter. Normalize per-vendor and combine with account exposure (token volume, pinned model usage). Iterate with Sales to weight signals based on feedback, then retrain using historical renewal labels where available.
